title: Sleep duration
text: Log lights-out and wake time each day; the app counts the hours between them. Naps count toward the total if the mission schedule allows them.
Under 7 hours scores watch (AASM/SRS consensus on adult sleep duration, 2015). Repeated short nights need the crew medical officer, especially before demanding tasks.

citations.source: AASM/SRS consensus on adult sleep duration (2015).
